awaiting_metrics.description: How many rows `analyze` would recompute right now. Shares Analyze.pending_metrics_count! with `plan`'s activities_awaiting_metrics, so the two commands cannot disagree, and it is the same predicate `analyze` selects on — beyond rows never scored it counts a changed FTP, a changed threshold pace, changed zones, a bumped metrics_rev, or any stored input column moving. Meaningless unless awaiting_metrics_known is true.

awaiting_metrics_known.description: False when the count could not be computed at all, in which case awaiting_metrics is 0 and must NOT be read as "nothing to do". config_error says why.

config_error.description: Why awaiting_metrics could not be computed, or "" when it could. `doctor` is the command whose job is to diagnose a broken installation, so it degrades and reports the reason rather than failing — this is the one place a config problem that blocks `analyze` is named. `plan` degrades silently on the same condition.

unanalyzed.description: Activities with no metrics row at all — never scored. A COVERAGE number, matching its neighbours here, which all report what the data has rather than whether it is current. It is NOT what `analyze` would recompute: see awaiting_metrics, which is never smaller.
